overview.en:
Inspect customer journeys and manage campaigns, newsletters, segments and workspace data in Customer.io.

Review audiences and email campaigns, then prepare content or campaign changes for approval. Use a specific campaign and date range when comparing results.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
在 Customer.io 中查看客户旅程，管理活动、简报、分群与工作区数据。

查看受众与邮件活动，再准备待审阅的内容或活动变更。比较效果时明确活动和时间范围。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize the available results for this email campaign.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总这个邮件活动的可用效果数据。

starterPrompts.en: Review this audience and propose a focused follow-up campaign.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查看这个受众群体，提出有针对性的后续活动方案。

starterPrompts.en: Draft the next campaign message using this brief and the available context.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 根据这份简报和可用上下文起草下一封活动邮件。

descriptions.en: Use Customer.io in Ghast. Inspect customer journeys and manage campaigns, newsletters, segments and workspace data in Customer.io. 在 Customer.io 中查看客户旅程，管理活动、简报、分群与工作区数据。
